messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Annex III, 2.1.2

2.1.2. Instructions for use The instructions for use for machinery or related products for foodstuffs and machinery or related products for cosmetics or pharmaceutical products shall indicate recommended products and methods for cleaning, disinfecting and rinsing, not only for easily accessible areas but also for areas to which access is impossible or inadvisable.

response.text:
Instructions for use | shallIndicate | recommended products and methods for cleaning, disinfecting and rinsing of easily accessible areas | machinery or related products for foodstuffs, cosmetics or pharmaceutical products | shall indicate recommended products and methods for cleaning, disinfecting and rinsing, not only for easily accessible areas
Instructions for use | shallIndicate | recommended products and methods for cleaning, disinfecting and rinsing of areas to which access is impossible or inadvisable | machinery or related products for foodstuffs, cosmetics or pharmaceutical products | but also for areas to which access is impossible or inadvisable
